_hinweis: Erkennungsmusik für „Zwischen den Zeilen“. Erzeugt mit Eleven Music (kommerziell nutzbar ab Starter-Plan). Gleicher Stil für alle Stücke, damit die Folge wie aus einem Guss klingt. Neu erzeugen: node werkzeuge/musik.mjs --neu NAME
stil: warm, upbeat modern indie-pop for a German morning podcast about social work: muted acoustic guitar, soft Rhodes piano, light drums with claps, 96 bpm, friendly and confident, clean professional mix, not cheesy, instrumental only

stuecke.name: intro
stuecke.prompt: A 3-second podcast intro sting. A bright, catchy two-chord motif that lands on a clean, resolved final hit. Starts immediately, no fade-in.

stuecke.name: thema
stuecke.prompt: A 7-second podcast theme that opens the show: confident groove with a short memorable melody, ending on a clear resolved chord so a voice can start right after.

stuecke.name: uebergang
stuecke.prompt: A 4-second podcast transition between topics: a short light groove with a soft drum fill and a warm guitar lick, ending cleanly.

stuecke.name: outro
stuecke.prompt: A 10-second podcast outro: the groove plays the main motif once more and winds down to a final resolved chord with a natural ending.
